offline_cases.description: Verify deterministic total, largest category, and budget status for the synthetic statement.
Verify a bounded category-and-merchant aggregation query.
Verify that protected categories are excluded from a deterministic saving plan.
Verify that the demo scenario can produce insight, evidence query, and a protected saving plan.

live_cases.prompt: Why did I spend so much this month? Analyse the overall pattern and the transactions that contributed most.
What is my largest spending category this month? Show the overall evidence and inspect the transactions behind it.
Investigate whether my Lifestyle and Social spending is unusually high. Start with the monthly pattern, then inspect supporting transactions.
Am I close to my S$1,800 monthly limit? Explain the main spending pressure using both the overview and transaction evidence.
Help me understand whether Food and Dining or Shopping is driving my spending. Review the monthly totals and relevant transaction details.
I want to save S$200. Analyse the evidence first, then create a practical plan without reducing Food and Dining or Transport.
I need to save S$100 this month. Analyse my spending first and give a plan, but keep Food and Dining protected.
How can I reduce spending by S$300 while keeping Transport? Use the overview and transaction evidence before creating a savings plan.
I want a S$150 saving plan. Please examine the evidence and do not reduce Food and Dining or Transport.
Find a realistic way to cut S$250 this month. Investigate the spending pattern, inspect the transactions, and create a plan that preserves Food and Dining.
